item.title: Ousted leader Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh from exile on Dec. 16, spokesperson says
item.description: Ousted Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home from exile in India on Dec. 16, the day the country celebrates as Victory Day when it won independence after a war with Pakistan.

item.title: Asian stocks rally after Wall Street rebound as Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia’s CEO
item.description: Asian stocks have surged after a rally on Wall Street, where Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia pushed benchmarks sharply higher.

item.title: Records: Government, judge debated constitutional implications of searching Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
item.description: A magistrate judge who authorized a search of U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home by federal agents has ruled that the Minnesota Democrat was entitled to assert her right to privacy protections afforded to sitting members of Congress at the outset of the search.

item.title: China unveils new space mission crew, with a Pakistani astronaut set to board its space station
item.description: China has unveiled the crew for its Shenzhou 24 spacecraft, set to launch this week. A Pakistani astronaut, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, will become the first foreign astronaut to board China's space station.

item.title: Man with Alzheimer's rescued in Amazon rainforest after surviving for 11 days, park ranger reveals
item.description: An older man with Alzheimer’s disease who survived 11 days on his own in the Amazon rainforest is currently recovering at a hospital in the Brazilian city of Macapa.
